WayArs reads order details (price, distance, time) shown on screen by delivery/taxi apps to help you decide faster. It never taps or modifies anything automatically.

WayArs uses Android’s AccessibilityService API. It is needed for the app’s core feature: automatically reading order offers on the screen of the delivery and ride apps you use, so WayArs can calculate your net profit and show a verdict (good / average / bad) in a floating overlay while scanning is on.

How it is used:
• It reads the text shown by the supported apps (and any apps you add yourself) when an order offer appears: price, distance and estimated time.
• Passwords, messages and anything you type are never read. Everything shown by other apps is ignored immediately.
• It never taps, types, scrolls or changes anything on screen, and it is not used to record calls.

What happens with the data:
• It is processed only on this device to calculate profit. Nothing is sent to a server, shared, sold or used for advertising.
• For orders you accept, only summary figures (price, distance, time, profit) are saved on this device for your statistics.

You stay in control: the service works only after you turn it on in Android settings, and you can turn it off at any time. If you also enable the optional notification access, WayArs reads only the notifications of supported apps about new orders.

"**WayArs**
Your personal delivery and rideshare assistant

Version: %1$s

WayArs is a subscription-based tool built for drivers and couriers working with ride-hailing and delivery apps.

The app automatically analyzes on-screen data and notifications, helping you quickly judge whether an order is worth taking and track your earnings in real time.

**Contact and support:** apstudiomobile@gmail.com

All third-party trademarks, logos, and app names (including but not limited to Bolt, Uber, Wolt, FreeNow, Stuart, and any others added by the user) belong to their respective owners and are used solely for informational and identification purposes."

"**WayArs Privacy Policy**
Last updated: October 8, 2026

**Protecting your privacy**
We respect your privacy. WayArs is developed and operated by Arsenii Panicev (AP STUDIO), an independent developer. WayArs is designed around Privacy by Design — the core screen-analysis and rate-calculation operations run locally on your device.

**Data collection and use**
• Accessibility Service: the app uses this access exclusively to read order details (e.g. price, distance) shown on screen by the supported delivery and taxi apps (built in and added by you) in order to calculate order profitability. The app does not record passwords, personal data or keystrokes. Data read through the service is processed locally on your device, is not sent to external servers, and is not shared with third parties or used for advertising. The service never taps, types or changes anything on the screen and is not used to record calls. Events from all other apps are ignored immediately: nothing from them is read or stored. Before the service can be enabled, the app shows a disclosure and asks for your consent, and you can turn it off at any time.
• Notifications (Notification Listener): notification access is optional and is used only to detect new order offers from the supported apps while the app runs in the background. Other notifications are not read or stored.
• Order history: for the statistics screen the app saves, on your device only, the amount, currency, distance, time, calculated rates, estimated fuel cost, net profit and verdict of each evaluated order and whether you accepted it. It contains no addresses, names or other personal details and is never sent anywhere.
• Vehicle and rate data: data you enter in Settings (fuel consumption, fuel price, evaluation thresholds) is stored only in local device storage.
• Free trial: to provide the one-time free trial of scanning, the app stores on your device a counter of how long scanning has run. It is not sent anywhere.
• Installed apps list: when you add an app to scan, the app shows the launchable apps installed on your device. The list is not stored or sent anywhere; only the apps you choose are saved locally.
• Floating overlay: the “display over other apps” permission is used only to show the order verdict card above the delivery or taxi app. No data is collected through it.
• App updates: the app asks Google Play whether a newer version is available (Google Play in-app updates API).

**Subscriptions and third-party providers**
The app offers features on a subscription basis. The app does not collect or store detailed payment data (such as credit card numbers). To process transactions and verify subscription status, we rely on trusted third-party providers:
• Google Play Billing (Google LLC): payments and transactions are handled directly by the Google Play Store. Policy: policies.google.com/privacy
• RevenueCat, Inc.: subscription status verification based on anonymous device and transaction identifiers. RevenueCat may also process technical connection data such as an IP address. Policy: revenuecat.com/privacy

**Children’s privacy**
WayArs is intended solely for adults who are legally permitted to work as a driver or courier. The app is not directed at children under 16 and does not knowingly collect or process any personal data from children. If you become aware that a child has provided us with any data, please contact us at apstudiomobile@gmail.com so we can take appropriate action promptly.

**Managing permissions and your subscription**
You can revoke granted permissions at any time in Android system settings, or manage and cancel your subscription directly in your Google Play account settings.

**Data deletion and retention**
WayArs has no user accounts, and we do not operate our own servers that store your personal data. Data entered in the app is stored locally on your device and can be deleted at any time by clearing the app data (Android Settings → Apps → WayArs → Storage → Clear data) or by uninstalling the app. The app does not use Android automatic cloud backup, so your local data is not copied to your Google account. To request deletion of technical subscription identifiers processed by RevenueCat, contact us at apstudiomobile@gmail.com.

**Contact**
Developer: AP STUDIO (Arsenii Panicev)
apstudiomobile@gmail.com"

"**WayArs Terms of Use**
Last updated: September 12, 2026

**General provisions**
By using the WayArs app, you accept the terms below. The app is an independent helper tool built by AP STUDIO and is not officially affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by any third-party app providers (such as Bolt, Uber, Wolt, FreeNow, Stuart, or any others added to the list by the user).

**Auxiliary nature and third-party apps**
• The app is for informational and analytical purposes only. Profitability indicators (currency/km, estimated profit) are calculated from data entered by the user and readings taken from the screen.
• Users may add supported third-party apps themselves. AP STUDIO does not guarantee correct data reading for apps added manually by the user.

**User age**
Only people who are at least 18 years old (or have reached the age required to provide rideshare/courier services in their country) may use the app. The app is not intended for children.

**Subscriptions and payments**
• Subscription payments are collected by the Google Play Store according to the selected plan.
• Users may cancel subscription renewal at any time in their Google Play account settings.
• Refunds are handled according to Google Play Store policies and rules.

**Disclaimer**
• AP STUDIO is not responsible for discrepancies in calculations resulting from incorrect screen reading, or updates or changes to third-party apps' interfaces.
• AP STUDIO is not responsible for financial, business, or driving decisions made by the user based on the app's indicators.
• Users are required to use their phone safely and strictly follow traffic laws while driving.
• AP STUDIO is not responsible for any blocks, temporary or permanent suspensions of the user’s accounts on third-party services (Uber, Bolt, Wolt, etc.).
• The user uses the app entirely at their own risk and independently decides whether to use it.
• The app is an independent helper tool and has no official connection to any rideshare or delivery platform.

**Contact**
Any questions, comments, or bug reports should be sent to: apstudiomobile@gmail.com."

Hi! I\'m %1$s. Help me hatch: make smart decisions about orders!
Switch on “Active” and I\'ll watch the orders for you.

How do I start reading orders?
Turn on the “Active” switch at the top of the home screen. While it\'s on, I watch new orders and show my verdict over the delivery or taxi app.
Why doesn\'t the card appear over the order?
In Settings → Permissions check that the accessibility service is on and “Display over other apps” is allowed, and that “Active” is switched on. Also set battery mode to “Unrestricted” for WayArs.
Why does WayArs ask for accessibility access again?
Android turns the accessibility service off when an app is force-stopped in system settings. Turn it on again, and next time stop scanning with the “Active” switch instead.
My app isn\'t on the list. How do I add it?
Settings → Supported apps → “Pick from installed apps”, then choose your delivery or taxi app.
How do I calibrate an app?
Open the app and wait for any order, then come back: Settings → Supported apps → the pencil next to the app. Tap the price, the distance and the time — done.
The currency of your country, or the one your delivery or taxi app shows prices in. All rates and limits are counted in it.
How do I set my tax?
Settings → Tax: enter your rate in %. It\'s subtracted together with fuel, so the card shows what you really keep.
Where do I enter my car and fuel?
Settings → Vehicle: type, fuel, consumption per 100 km and fuel price. Then every order shows the amount after fuel.
How do I set my own limits?
Settings → My limits: set the rate per km for bad, average and good orders. They replace the preset.
Ready-made strategies (economy, balance, only profitable) that decide which orders count as good. Pick one on the Presets tab.
Where are my earnings and statistics?
On the Statistics tab: orders, earnings, distance and average rate for today, the week or the month.
What do green and red mean?
Green — the order pays off with your settings, red — it doesn\'t. The rate per km and per minute is already after fuel.
Settings → Subscription. First you get 30 minutes of free trial; the subscription is linked to your Google account and managed in Google Play.
Settings → Contact us: Telegram, Instagram, TikTok or e-mail. We answer any time.
I eat energy from smart decisions: accept a good order or reject a bad one and I get +3. Every day you switch on scanning gives +5. More energy — higher level!
Something doesn\'t work. What should I check?
Tap “🔍 Check my phone” at the top of this window: I\'ll check permissions, “Active”, subscription and battery and show what to fix.
Which apps does WayArs work with?
Uber, Bolt (Driver and Courier), Wolt, FreeNow and Stuart are built in. Any other delivery or taxi app can be added in Settings → Supported apps.
Does WayArs accept orders for me?
No. WayArs only reads the screen and shows its verdict. It never taps, accepts or rejects anything in Uber, Bolt or other apps — you decide.
No. Orders are read and calculated on your phone; the screen content isn\'t sent anywhere. Details are in “Privacy Policy” at the bottom of Settings.
The numbers in the card are wrong. What do I do?
Calibrate the app: Settings → Supported apps → the pencil. If it still reads wrong, send a screenshot of the order via Settings → Contact us and we\'ll fix it.
How do I move the card?
Hold the card and drag it anywhere on the screen.
What do the buttons on the card do?
✓ — you took the order, it\'s saved to your statistics. ✗ or × — you skipped it. They only tell WayArs your decision: accept or reject the order in the delivery or taxi app itself.
How is the net amount calculated?
Order amount minus partner commission, fuel (distance × consumption × fuel price) and your tax. The rate per km and per minute uses the amount after fuel.
Why is the time empty or 0?
Some apps don\'t show the trip time (for example FreeNow shows only the distance). Then the verdict is based on the rate per km.
Is the drive to the customer counted?
Yes. For taxi orders the distance and time include the drive to the pickup and the trip itself.
How long is the free trial?
30 minutes of scanning in total. The time only runs while “Active” is on. After that a subscription is needed.
I paid but the subscription isn\'t active.
Open the subscription screen and tap “Restore purchases”. Check that the phone uses the same Google account you paid with.
How do I cancel the subscription?
Google Play → your profile → Payments and subscriptions → Subscriptions → WayArs → Cancel.
How do I change the language?
How do I replay the tutorial?
Settings → Tutorial, at the bottom of the settings.
Why does “Active” turn off by itself?
The free trial ended, the subscription lapsed or the accessibility service was switched off. If Android closed WayArs in the background, “Active” comes back on by itself.
Does it work with WayArs minimized?
Yes, WayArs works in the background. The order itself must be on the screen: WayArs reads what the delivery or taxi app shows.
Can I use several apps at once?
Yes. WayArs watches all supported apps at the same time and shows which app each order comes from.
Very little: it only reads text when a supported app changes its screen. Set the battery mode to “Unrestricted” so Android doesn\'t stop it.
Why aren\'t my orders in the statistics?
Only orders you mark with ✓ on the card are saved. Skipped orders aren\'t counted.
It\'s optional: a backup way to catch orders that arrive as a notification while the order app is minimized. Turn it on in Settings → Permissions.
Does it work in my country?
Yes: WayArs reads orders in any language and currency, with km, miles or metres. Just choose your currency in Settings.
How do I reset a calibration?
Settings → Supported apps → the pencil next to the app → “Clear calibration”.
Where are the privacy policy and terms?
At the bottom of Settings: “Privacy Policy” and “Terms of Use”.

How much do I really earn per hour?
Stats → the top card “Real per hour, take-home”: your take-home divided by all the time “Active” was on, waiting between orders included. Pick Today, Week, Month or Year.
Which app pays me more — Bolt or Uber?

Stats → “Which app pays more (60 days)”: each app\'s real per-hour over 60 days, and by weekday and time of day, e.g. “Thursday evening: Bolt 34/h · Uber 26/h”. Mark accepted orders with ✓ on the card so I can count them; each app needs at least 2 orders.
I drive through a partner (fleet). How do I count its commission?
Settings → “Partner (fleet)”: enter the commission % and the weekly payment. The order card then shows “partner −…” and what stays in your hand; statistics subtract the weekly payment.
Where is the partner\'s weekly payment subtracted?
In Stats: the “Real per hour, take-home” card subtracts the share of the weekly payment for the chosen period (a week — all of it, a day — 1/7). The order card subtracts only the commission %.
How do I get the day and week summary?

Settings → “Extras” → “Day and week summaries”. At 21:00 (if “Active” is still on — once you switch it off, no later than 23:30) you get the day\'s result, on Monday at 9:00 — the week\'s. Notifications must be allowed.
How do I add the widget to the home screen?
Settings → “Extras” → “Add widget”, or hold an empty spot on the home screen → Widgets → WayArs. It shows today\'s earnings and switches “Active” on and off.

Stats → “Achievements”: days in a row without accepting an unprofitable order (days off don\'t break the streak), record per hour, best day and best order, badges for 3, 7 and 30 smart days, 100 and 1000 orders, 100 hours.
How do I invite a colleague and get a free month?

Settings → “Extras” → “Invite”: send the link to a colleague — your code is already in the message. When the friend subscribes, both of you write to us on Telegram t.me/wayars_app: you — that you invited them, the friend — your code and a screenshot of the Google Play receipt with the order number (GPA.…). After we check it, you get a free month.
How do I get the verdict on my watch?

Settings → “Extras” → “Verdict on the watch”. A Wear OS watch vibrates: 1 short — profitable, 2 short — not, 1 long — average. In the Galaxy Wearable or Pixel Watch app allow WayArs notifications; on a Galaxy Watch also allow notifications while using the phone, otherwise the watch stays quiet while the phone screen is on.
